description: Checks one public website for how readable it is to AI assistants and search engines. Loads up to 5 pages with read-only requests and returns free results: overall scores (AI visibility/GEO, SEO health, marketing health, protocol security, accessibility), up to three top findings each with a plain-English fix, and counts of further findings not listed.

industry.description: Industry of the site, used as context (default: general)

max_pages.description: Pages to load. The free check loads at most 5; larger values are reduced to 5.

url.description: The public website address to check (e.g. https://example.com)

name: scan_website
title: Check a website's AI visibility
